inputs.message: bu-pi delivery review diagnostic; bub2-020; review disabled; same SDK and full Luna task controls; 20260908
bu-pi delivery review diagnostic; bub2-020; review enabled; same SDK and full Luna task controls; 20260908

purpose: One previously inspected task with one attempt per arm. Same SDK and controls; only delivery_review differs. Measure review adoption and correction, not ranking or parity.
required_audit: Both manifests, original attempts, task/model/reasoning/judge/budget controls and dependency locks.
Actual review submissions and subsequent source/file inspection; a second finish alone is not semantic review.
Source versus delivered exact values, synthetic/observed labels, source coverage and boundary violations before and after checkpoint.
Original outcome, actual judgment, provider/runtime failures, artifact inventory, screenshots, costs and owned-browser cleanup.

selection_context.full_cohort_selection: None. Retain remaining original Luna outcomes.

limitations: One selected development task, not independent generalization or statistical noninferiority.
First-stage live behavior can differ between arms before either reaches finish. Do not attribute all score differences to review.
A late check cannot undo a forbidden action or restore absent source evidence.
Original task, step, context, time and cost policies remain; review can cause budget exhaustion.
All original confirmation2 cohorts retain their own SDK pins and outcomes.
Costs are recorded agent estimates, excluding judge/browser/runner and unreported usage.
